notes: P1: chose Merian’s 1638 copy (#5) over the 1575 Braun and Hogenberg original, whose copies are two-page spreads with the gutter through the view (#1, #2, #6) or low resolution (#3); the 1638 date is from Commons (probably Merian’s Archontologia Cosmica). #7 (1669) is a black-and-white copy of the same plate. #8 dates from the Ottoman siege (1648–69) but shows no siege action. #9: the chart edition is 1897, the view comes from the 1843 survey. #10: date 1897 from Commons, likely Italian illustrated press during the Cretan crisis. #18 (1970, Agios Minas) is a fallback for P6.
